t: Lama en motziin shene sipre torot beshabbat
s: Lama en motziin shene sipre torot beshabbat ubo seip echad: ap shettiqqenu haggeonim lehotzi lekol yom tob seper sheni liqrot beparashat hammusapim — beshabbat lo tiqqenu ken, mippene shebbeparashat musap hashshabbat en bah ella b' pesuqim bilbad, veen qorin battora pachot mig' pesuqim, kemo shennitbaer besimman ql"z. Veod, lepi shetztzarik lehaptir benabi bekol shabbat meinyan happarasha sheqqara mimmenna hammaptir, veim yiqra bemusap shabbat — yitztarek lehaptir meinyan shabbat, veyihyu kol hahaptarot shel kol hashshana beinyan echad, mah sheen ken kesheqqore beparashat hashshabua — yaptir bekol shabbat meinyan otah happarasha:
